messages.content: Sort my inbox — which emails need a reply, which are notifications, and which are spam?

function.name: gmail_list_messages
function.description: Get the list of messages in the inbox

days_back.description: Number of recent days to fetch emails from

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return

function.name: gmail_get_message
function.description: Get the detailed content of an email by its message ID

function.name: Bash
function.description: Executes a given bash command and returns its output. The working directory persists between commands. Use this for system commands and terminal operations.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does.

run_in_background.description: Set to true to run this command in the background.

function.name: Read
function.description: Reads a file from the filesystem. Can read text files, images, and PDFs. For images, returns base64-encoded frames for visual inspection. For PDFs, use the pages parameter to render specific pages as images.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to read.

offset.description: The line number to start reading from (1-based).

limit.description: The number of lines to read.

function.name: Write
function.description: Writes a file to the filesystem. Creates parent directories if needed. Overwrites the existing file if there is one at the provided path.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to write.

content.description: The content to write to the file.

function.name: Edit
function.description: Performs exact string replacements in files. The edit will fail if old_string is not found or is not unique (unless replace_all is set).

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to modify.

new_string.description: The text to replace it with.

replace_all.description: Replace all occurrences of old_string (default false).

function.name: Glob
function.description: Fast file pattern matching tool. Supports glob patterns like '**/*.js' or 'src/**/*.ts'. Returns matching file paths.

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match files against.

path.description: The directory to search in. Defaults to /workspace.

function.name: Grep
function.description: Search tool for finding patterns in file contents. Supports regex syntax. Returns matching lines or file paths.

pattern.description: The regex pattern to search for.

path.description: File or directory to search in. Defaults to /workspace.

context_lines.description: Number of context lines before and after each match.

after_context.description: Number of lines to show after each match.

before_context.description: Number of lines to show before each match.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N entries.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where patterns can span lines.

function.name: BrowserScreenshot
function.description: Capture screenshots of a web page over time. Opens the URL in a headless browser, then takes multiple screenshots at regular intervals to show animation progress. Use this to preview and verify your generated web pages and animations.

url.description: The URL to navigate to and capture.

function.name: ReadMedia
function.description: Read and preview a video file. Extracts frames at specified intervals. Returns metadata and base64-encoded frame images.

media_type.description: Type of media: 'auto', 'image', 'video', or 'pdf'. Default: auto-detect.

max_frames.description: Maximum number of frames to extract (default: 8).

end_time.description: End time in seconds. None means end of video.

function.name: Download
function.description: Download a file as binary (base64-encoded). Use for retrieving generated files (mp4, gif, html, etc.).

path.description: Path to the file to download.
